obtained.how: an agency copy: the publisher's PDF posted by the New York State Lake George Park Commission as material for its septic-system review committee (July 2021); found through the Wayback Machine's index of lgpc.ny.gov, fetched live

bibliography.note: Science of the Total Environment 692 (2019) 640–652; Robertson, W. D., Van Stempvoort, D. R. & Schiff, S. L. — matches

claims.claim: plumes from 24 Ontario septic systems carried 0.1–76 mg/L nitrate-N even where most P was retained
claims.source_value: 0.1–76 mg/L is the range of mean nitrate-N in the proximal plumes at the NON-CALCAREOUS sites (13 with data), where P removal averaged 97 %; across all the sites with data it is 0.1–107 mg/L (LA School, a calcareous site, 107)
claims.conditions: site means in the proximal plume zone (within 10 m of the drainfield); Ontario, 1988–2018; nitrate exceeded ammonium in 21 of the 24 plumes and was > 90 % of inorganic N in 15 (p. 645)
claims.note: the sentence reads as if 0.1–76 spans all 24 plumes. Either say 'Plumes from 24 Ontario septic systems carried up to 107 mg/L nitrate-N' or keep 0.1–76 and say 'at the 13 non-calcareous sites, where most P was retained'. The 0.1 values are plumes that stayed reduced (ammonium 15–29 mg/L at JL and SM), so 'carried nitrate' needs that qualifier at the low end.

claims.claim: septic systems on non-calcareous soils retain most phosphorus; removal averaged 97 % at 13 non-calcareous Ontario sites
claims.location: p. 640 (PDF p. 1), Abstract; p. 649 (PDF p. 10), Discussion; p. 645 (PDF p. 6), Table 3
claims.quote: Removal considering both the drainfields and proximal plume zones, averaged 97% at the non-calcareous sites
claims.conditions: SRP removal relative to septic-tank effluent through the drainfield and the first 10 m of plume, dilution-corrected with chloride; non-calcareous = sediment Ca < 2 wt %
claims.note: drainfield removal alone averaged 90 % (n = 13); the 97 % plume figure is a mean over n = 8 sites in Table 3 (footnote b fills sites without plume samples with the drainfield value), though the abstract and text give it for 'the non-calcareous sites' generally. Calcareous sites: 66 % (drainfield) and 69 % (with plume).

claims.location: p. 645 (PDF p. 6), Table 3 (P plume length column, non-calcareous sites) and footnote e
claims.conditions: plume length is where P exceeds 0.1 mg/L (footnote e); the 13 non-calcareous sites with data; at the calcareous sites plumes ran 1.5 to 100 m (30+ at the reduced HH resort)
claims.note: values read on the page image; say 'plumes above 0.1 mg/L P reached only 1–4 m'.

claims.source_value: 97 % removal through the drainfield and proximal plume, 90 % in the drainfield alone, at the non-calcareous sites; the source classes the sites by sediment calcium (< 2 wt % Ca), not acidity, though most non-calcareous plumes were acidic (pH 3.5–7.0)
claims.location: p. 640 (PDF p. 1), Abstract; p. 645 (PDF p. 6), Table 3
claims.quote: Phosphorus removal in the drainfields averaged 90% at sites where sediments were non calcareous
claims.conditions: Ontario, 13 non-calcareous sites (cottages, houses, campgrounds, a resort, a motel)
claims.note: 95 % is the project's pick between the source's 90 and 97 % (the research note's table lists 0.95 as the value with range 0.69–0.99); say so in the comment: 'after ~95 % retention (Robertson 2019: 90 % in the drainfield, 97 % within 10 m, on non-calcareous sediments)'.

notes: The research note (shoreline_development_effects.md) already read this same agency copy and its numbers hold: 24 systems, 97 % vs 69 %, plumes 1–4 m, nitrate 0.1–76 (that last is the non-calcareous range only). Other useful values: septic-tank effluent SRP averaged 8.4 mg/L (1.8–13.8 by site; median 7.4 over 123 samples, Table 2); at 17 of 24 sites the proximal plume SRP was ≤ 1 mg/L; P retention showed no relation to site age (r² = 0.001); P was held mainly as secondary mineral coatings on the drainfield sand grains (seen at 23 of 24 sites; 1–15 wt % P; Al the dominant cation at 13 sites, Fe at 5, Ca + Fe at 3; p. 650). Cottage sites (HA, DY, JL) removed 96–99 % in the drainfield.
